retrievalProfile.description: A gritty urban aesthetic featuring low-angle perspective through industrial structures with high-contrast lighting and organic, hand-drawn typography.
triggerTerms: urban street photography through metal bars

recipe.visualDefinition: A dynamic, low-angle composition looking up at a subject framed by industrial metal bars against a red brick wall, characterized by high-contrast warm tones and fluid, white hand-drawn lettering.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject framed by foreground industrial elements
Low-angle perspective creating a sense of dominance
Warm brick textures contrasting with cool metallic highlights
Organic typography floating over a structured geometric background
coreInvariants: Industrial framing elements in the immediate foreground
High-contrast lighting with deep shadows and bright highlights

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central figure, medium-full shot, leaning forward into the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and the metallic foreground bars.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: From the top-left typography, down the diagonal of the foreground bars to the subject, then to the bottom-left logo and subtitle.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Limited; the frame is densely packed with texture and structural elements.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm terracotta and brick red in the background.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep shadows and dark blues in the upper sky/corners.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Bright white for typography and metallic silver for highlights.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the warm tones with high value contrast in the highlights.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid neon or pastel primary colors.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Fluid, organic script with varying line weights.
letterConstructionRules: Connected strokes in a casual, graffiti-influenced style
characterSpecificRedesigns: Lowercase 'a' with a long, sweeping tail
Interlocking initials for the logo mark
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Organic script for names paired with a stylized geometric monogram.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the urban, hand-drawn aesthetic of the primary text.
Necessary for the stylized 'AP' logo mark.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a low-angle urban photograph of a person in streetwear looking down at the camera, framed by rusty metal bars, with a red brick wall background and high-contrast lighting.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add hand-drawn white script text in an arc at the top and a metallic circular monogram badge in the bottom left corner.

verificationChecks: Is the typography hand-drawn in style?
Is the color palette dominated by warm brick tones?

adjustableVariables: Intensity of the red brick saturation
postGenerationChecks: Check for high-contrast metallic highlights on foreground elements.
Ensure the text follows an organic, non-linear path.
Verify the brick texture is sharp and detailed.
Confirm the low-angle perspective is maintained.
recipe.reuseFormula: Urban Perspective + Industrial Framing + Hand-Drawn Script + Warm High-Contrast Lighting
